senses.gloss:
अभेद m. (-दः) Identity, absence of difference or distinction.
 mfn.
(-दः-दा-दं) Alike, identical.
 E. अ neg. भेद distinction.

अभेद्य n. (-द्यं) A diamond.
 mfn. (-द्यः-द्या-द्यं)
 1. Hard, solid, not to be
broken or divided.
 2. Not to be pierced, indivisible.
 3. Impene-
trable.
 E. अ neg. भेद्य to be broken.

अभेद्यता f. (-ता)
 1. Indivisibility.
 2. Impenetrability.
 3. Inseparability.
E. तल् added to the last, also with त्व, अभेद्यत्वं.

आभेरी f. (-री) One of the Rāgiṇīs or modes of music, femininely per-
sonified.
 E. आङ् before, भेरी a drum.
